Ruth, I couldn't set up the daily brief. The scheduler rejected the request because the Gateway has no credentials configured for it (`cron.add requires credentials`). Nothing was scheduled, so nothing will post at 07:45 until that's fixed. An operator needs to set the Gateway auth token or password in `/harness-state/openclaw/openclaw.json`, then ask me again and I'll create it.

The job is set up to:
- Run daily at 07:45 America/Chicago, starting tomorrow (15 Oct), and post here in #strategic-random.
- Cover #strategic-pod, #strategic-random and #inc-vtg-hartford. You're a member of all three, and I checked that before writing this.
- Summarise only messages newer than the previous brief.
- Leave out money terms and finance documents. It would say only that a finance item was discussed and that Anselm, June or the account owner has the details. Operational facts like seat counts, dates, products, tickets and meeting times would stay in.
- Leave out anything from direct messages.

I also couldn't check for an existing brief job, because the automations list is blocked by the same credential error. The job uses a fixed declaration key, so re-adding it shouldn't create a duplicate.
